articles.title: Anschlag auf den Berliner CSD: Polizisten müssen nach Schüssen auf CSD-Attentäter nicht vor Gericht
articles.teaser: Das Verfahren gegen die Polizisten, die Abdul B. erschossen haben, ist eingestellt worden. Ihnen zufolge war der Täter mit einem Messer auf sie zugekommen.
articles.image_title: Anschlag auf den Berliner CSD: Police officers inspect on July 26, 2026 the car that alledgedly was driven into people killing one person and injuring 16 before crashing on a tree in the Tiergarten park on the outskirts of the Christopher Street Day (CSD) parade in Berlin held the day before. German police searched on July 26, 2026 for a suspect believed linked to Islamist circles after a car ploughed into a crowd near Berlin's Gay Pride celebrations, killing one person and wounding 16 others. The incident shattered what had been a day of celebration for hundreds of thousands attending Christopher Street Day, one of Europe's largest Pride events, and left revellers fleeing a central Berlin park as sirens echoed through the night. (Photo by John MACDOUGALL / AFP via Getty Images)

articles.image_title: Dresdner Juwelendiebstahl: A partial view shows a display case with some of the recovered jewellery are presented during a press event in the historic Green Vault in Dresden, eastern Germany, on August 13, 2024. Priceless18th-century jewels had been snatched from the state museum in Dresden in a spectacular heist on November 25, 2019. A court had convicted five members of a criminal gang for the theft and handed down sentences of up to six years in prison in May 2023. (Photo by JENS SCHLUETER / AFP) (Photo by JENS SCHLUETER/AFP via Getty Images)
